name: An emblem's triggered ability is fired from the emblem — Tezzeret the Schemer's emblem; an emblem is never a target
notes: Memory: project_emblem_abilities_fired_2026-11-11. An emblem had no abilities in its state (Battlefield.addEmblem gave its pseudo-permanent printedAbilities []), so the Emblem panel could show its text but nothing on it could be fired or targeted. Its abilities now come from its text and the panel has a Trigger / Activate button per ability, firing it as a permanent's ability popup does, with the emblem as the source (CR 113.7, 114.4): its controller is the emblem's owner. Tezzeret the Schemer's emblem fired: its picker lists the artifacts you control (Sol Ring, Ornithopter), not your Grizzly Bears or the opponent's Mind Stone, and the chosen Sol Ring becomes a 5/5 artifact creature. An emblem is no permanent: a 'target permanent you control' picker (Tamiyo's Safekeeping) listed the emblem; the four target pickers, the equip list and the exchange-control list leave emblems out, and effectAppliesToPerm never applies an effect to one. A board saved with a fired emblem ability lost it on restore (emblems were re-added after fired abilities, with new ids); emblems are saved with their id and timestamp and re-added first.

abilities: At the beginning of combat on your turn, target artifact you control becomes an artifact creature with base power and toughness 5/5.
